objects.description: Packed HID input report structure for the Sony DualShock 3 controller, beginning with report ID 0x01. Provides button bitfields, thumbstick axes, analog pressure values, battery status, and basic motion sensors (accelerometers and gyro). Intended to be read directly from the device; layout depends on 1-byte packing.

objects.definition:
typedef struct _XINPUT_HID_INPUT_REPORT
 {
	 // No REPORT ID byte
	 // Collection: CA:GamePad CP:
	 USHORT GD_GamePadX;                              // Usage 0x00010030: X, Value = 0 to 65535
	 USHORT GD_GamePadY;                              // Usage 0x00010031: Y, Value = 0 to 65535
	 USHORT GD_GamePadRx;                             // Usage 0x00010033: Rx, Value = 0 to 65535
	 USHORT GD_GamePadRy;                             // Usage 0x00010034: Ry, Value = 0 to 65535
										// Collection: CA:GamePad
	 USHORT GD_GamePadZ : 10;                         // Usage 0x00010032: Z, Value = 0 to 1023
	 USHORT GD_GamePadRz : 10;                        // Usage 0x00010035: Rz, Value = 0 to 1023
	 UCHAR  BTN_GamePadButton1 : 1;                   // Usage 0x00090001: Button 1 Primary/trigger, Value = 0 to 0
	 UCHAR  BTN_GamePadButton2 : 1;                   // Usage 0x00090002: Button 2 Secondary, Value = 0 to 0
	 UCHAR  BTN_GamePadButton3 : 1;                   // Usage 0x00090003: Button 3 Tertiary, Value = 0 to 0
	 UCHAR  BTN_GamePadButton4 : 1;                   // Usage 0x00090004: Button 4, Value = 0 to 0
	 UCHAR  BTN_GamePadButton5 : 1;                   // Usage 0x00090005: Button 5, Value = 0 to 0
	 UCHAR  BTN_GamePadButton6 : 1;                   // Usage 0x00090006: Button 6, Value = 0 to 0
	 UCHAR  BTN_GamePadButton7 : 1;                   // Usage 0x00090007: Button 7, Value = 0 to 0
	 UCHAR  BTN_GamePadButton8 : 1;                   // Usage 0x00090008: Button 8, Value = 0 to 0
	 UCHAR  BTN_GamePadButton9 : 1;                   // Usage 0x00090009: Button 9, Value = 0 to 0
	 UCHAR  BTN_GamePadButton10 : 1;                  // Usage 0x0009000A: Button 10, Value = 0 to 0
	 UCHAR : 6;                                      // Pad
	 UCHAR  GD_GamePadHatSwitch : 4;                  // Usage 0x00010039: Hat switch, Value = 1 to 8, Physical = (Value - 1) x 45 in degrees
	 UCHAR : 4;                                      // Pad
										// Collection: CA:GamePad CP:SystemControl
	 UCHAR  GD_GamePadSystemControlSystemMainMenu : 1; // Usage 0x00010085: System Main Menu, Value = 0 to 1
	 UCHAR : 7;                                      // Pad
										// Collection: CA:GamePad
	 UCHAR  GEN_GamePadBatteryStrength;               // Usage 0x00060020: Battery Strength, Value = 0 to 255
 } XINPUT_HID_INPUT_REPORT, * PXINPUT_HID_INPUT_REPORT;
objects.description: Packed HID input report layout matching an XInput-compatible GamePad without a report ID byte. Contains 16-bit axes (X, Y, Rx, Ry), 10-bit triggers (Z, Rz), buttons as bitfields, a 4-bit hat switch, a system main menu button, and a battery strength byte. Derived from public HID descriptor documentation; relies on 1-byte packing.

Packed structure (1-byte alignment) defining a custom SCP report format for DualShock 3 controllers. It stores normalized or raw floating-point values for D-pad directions (UP, RIGHT, DOWN, LEFT), left stick axes (LX, LY), left shoulder/trigger/button states (L1, L2, L3), right stick axes (RX, RY), right shoulder/trigger/button states (R1, R2, R3), face buttons (T, C, X, S likely Triangle, Circle, Cross, Square), SELECT, START, and PS button. Exact value ranges and semantics are not documented in this header and may depend on the producing API. The structure is laid out tightly due to pshpack1/poppack usage.

A constant GUID identifying the DsHidMini device interface class. It is used for device enumeration/opening via the Windows device interface mechanism. Note: DEFINE_GUID expands to a GUID constant definition; the underlying type is GUID. No new struct/typedef is introduced here.

A device property key for read/write HidDeviceMode used by the driver during startup/shutdown. Applications may read only. Underlying type is DEVPROPKEY; this macro defines a constant key, not a new type.
A read-only device property key reporting battery status during operation. Underlying type is DEVPROPKEY constant.
A deprecated read-only device property key exposing the last pairing status (NTSTATUS). The symbol is marked deprecated. Underlying is a DEVPROPKEY constant.
A read-only device property key providing identification data as binary. Underlying is a DEVPROPKEY constant.
A read-only device property key for the last host request status (NTSTATUS). Underlying is a DEVPROPKEY constant.

functions.name: DS3_RAW_IS_IDLE
functions.description: Returns TRUE if a DualShock 3 raw input report represents an idle controller state (no buttons pressed, sticks within jitter thresholds, and L2/R2 pressure not engaged), otherwise FALSE. Intended for quickly filtering out minor jitter/noise in raw DS3 reports before processing input.
requirements: Input must be a valid, non-null pointer to a DS3_RAW_INPUT_REPORT structure populated from a native DualShock 3 input report that starts with ReportId 0x01.
The structure layout must use 1-byte packing (as defined around the struct) so field offsets match the native report.
Button and axis fields should contain raw DS3 values (axes 0x00–0xFF; pressure sliders 0x00–0xFF) as described by the struct comments; the function compares against defined idle thresholds.
The function performs no allocation or I/O and has no side effects; callers may invoke it at any time with a valid report.
Return value must be checked by the caller: TRUE indicates idle, FALSE indicates active input.
